tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows elevated creatinine, total bilirubin, and chloride, with low total protein, total CO₂, and ALT. These findings suggest possible renal dysfunction and significant hyperbilirubinemia, potentially indicating hepatic or biliary pathology. The low total protein and CO₂ may reflect metabolic or nutritional disturbances. Further clinical correlation and additional diagnostic workup are recommended.
